welcome.title: AI Article Summarizer is installed
welcome.intro: It summarizes any article in seconds, with key points, translation and questions.
welcome.step1: Pin the icon to the toolbar: extensions menu (the puzzle piece) ▸ gear next to the extension ▸ “Pin to Toolbar”.
welcome.step2: Connect an AI service: create a key and paste it below. Groq is a good start, sign-up is free.
welcome.step3: Open an article and press “Summarize this page”.
settings.steps.groq: Sign up for free at console.groq.com ▸ API Keys ▸ create a key ▸ paste it here.
settings.steps.openai: Sign up and add credit at platform.openai.com ▸ API Keys ▸ create a key ▸ paste it here.
settings.steps.anthropic: Sign up at console.anthropic.com ▸ API Keys ▸ create a key ▸ paste it here.
settings.steps.gemini: Sign in with your Google account at aistudio.google.com ▸ Create API Key ▸ paste it here.
